notes: All Table 5 odds ratios, parenthesized SEs, fit statistics and Table 6 effects/SEs were read against PDF images, not inferred from garbled extraction. Printed 0.000 or 0.0000 SEs are rounded values, not known exact zeros. Coefficients on the log-odds scale, exact p-values, intercepts, fixed effects, covariance matrices and numeric Figure 3 predictions are not printed and are not reconstructed here. The SE scale for odds ratios is not explicitly identified. Hypothesis directions refer to underlying slopes, with remaining time increasing away from the deadline. No-star entries do not give exact p-values. To honor the assignment restriction that published sample sizes/counts belong only in sealed_N_branch.json, all N fields here are null and model Ns/counts/percentage frequencies are retained only in that file. Percent-valued seven-point effect examples are effects, not sample percentages. Table 1 and Table 4 descriptives are diagnostic only; their data are never empirical inputs.
